case_number: CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3799 OF 2023 (ARISING OUT OF SLP (C) NO. 17062/2022)
summary: Railway accident compensation claim; untoward incident vs bona fide passenger status; burden shifting after initial proof of circumstance; death via decapitation during fall from train; FIR, inquest report, post-mortem establishing accident cause; Railway Claims Tribunal and High Court dismissal reversed; Railways Act s.123(c)(2), s.124A liability standards applied; compensation entitlement confirmed.
legal_provisions_cited: Union of India v. Rina Devi (2019) 3 SCC 572
Union of India v. Radha Yadav (2019) 3 SCC 410
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Claims Tribunal and High Court judgments set aside; compensation awarded with interest.
